notes: The length-biased fixture judge rewards the padded variant and fails the equally-correct short variant on every length trial (magnitude 1.0); its Wilson upper bound (1.0) exceeds the 0.35 threshold, so the must-pass length probe fails and the overall verdict is BIASED with failed_biases=[length]. It is fair on self_preference/sycophancy/compassion_fade (magnitude 0.0). enforce_bias_gate raises BiasedJudgeError even though the judge holds a CERTIFIED calibration record (the bias gate is orthogonal to accuracy).
